questions.

Where do you provide service?

King’s serves Lansing, Michigan and surrounding communities. Share your property location so the team can confirm whether you’re in the service area.

Do you work with homes and businesses?

Call (517) 894-1648 or email kingslawncareservicesllc@gmail.com with your location and lawn-care needs. Confirm pricing, availability, and service details directly with the team.
